description: This file defines setup and configuration logic for the 'Tlon' channel in an OpenClaw-based application, including functions for creating setup wizards, resolving configuration status, applying configurations, and a setup adapter.

methods.name: tlonChannelId
methods.description: Returns the constant string 'tlon' representing the channel ID.

methods.name: createTlonSetupWizardBase
methods.description: Creates a setup wizard object for Tlon configuration with status, intro note, input validation, and finalize logic.

methods.name: resolveTlonSetupConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the Tlon account(s) are configured based on existing account data.

methods.name: resolveTlonSetupStatusLines
methods.description: Generates status lines indicating whether Tlon is configured for a given account.

methods.name: applyTlonSetupConfig
methods.description: Applies user input to update the OpenClaw configuration for a Tlon account.
